MLX fast path verified bit-identical to the HF reference (g-values exact, reweight max prob diff 2.98e-08) before generating.
caveat: Output was almost entirely <think> reasoning chains, so the z above measures the watermark on reasoning traces. The original guess that this depressed mean_g because reasoning is low-entropy was tested and refuted; see entropy_followup.

entropy_followup.result: REFUTES the hypothesis in the original caveat. Reasoning is the HIGHER-entropy span, not the lower one. The depressed mean_g is better explained as a model-level property (R1-distill 4bit runs 0.659 bits/tok overall vs 1.19 for Qwen3.5-4B prose, ~0.55x).
caveats: A first attempt was confounded: short factual prompts made answers deterministic strings, giving a meaningless 0.41x. Re-run with prose prompts gave 0.49x, same direction.
The two prompts contributed unevenly (one supplied nearly all reasoning tokens, the other nearly all answer tokens), so this is closer to a cross-prompt than a within-prompt comparison.
The comparison to Qwen3.5-4B prose is cross-model and not controlled.
